v22_result.description: A flagged bundle with two assertions, a marker and a tolerated failing assertion. Expect run/config/devtool/results/v22_result-<tick>.json listing both assertions with outcomes, the marker, and no failures.
commands: devtool assert entities count 1 within 12 name v22pig

commands.command: devtool assert entities count 2 within 12 name v22pig

v22_nested_parent.description: A flagged parent that runs a flagged child. Expect two result files; the parent's has only its own markers and the child's only its own.

v22_nested_child.description: The child of the nested pair.

v22_unflagged_control.description: No result flag. Expect no new file in the results directory.

v22_cleanup.description: Removes the pig and stops the session.
